description: Everything an event publishes about one person on its programme: their job title line, `role` (a speaker-level note such as "Moderator"), company, bio, expertise tags, public social links, a portrait, a link to the organizer's own profile page, and every session they are on with the spoken local time. Accepts a name or a speakerId. If the name is not clear enough to be sure - two people sharing a surname, say - the reply is a not-found carrying the closest names rather than a guess, so ask the person which one they meant. Absent fields are null: the organizer published nothing there, so say nothing rather than filling the gap.

eventIdOrSlug.description: Event id (belmont_stroll), public slug (cba26), or the event NAME as events_list spells it ("Summer Stroll & Savor"). Common short forms work too ("the stroll", "tie summit").

speaker.description: A speaker name ("Aasif Mandvi", or just a surname) or a speakerId as events_speakers returns it
